The working tree and the index are updated to match the branch. All new commits will be added to the tip of this branch. Optionally a new branch could be created with either -c , -C , automatically from a remote branch of same name (see --guess ), or detach the working tree from any branch with --detach , along with switching. Switching branches does not require a clean index and working tree (i.e. no differences compared to HEAD ). The operation is aborted however if the operation leads to loss of local changes, unless told otherwise with --discard-changes or --merge . OPTIONS <branch> Branch to switch to. <new-branch> Name for the new branch. <start-point> The starting point for the new branch. Specifying a <start-point> allows you to create a branch based on some other point in history than where HEAD currently points. (Or, in the case of --detach , allows you to inspect and detach from some other point.)
